name: product_sale_team
summary: Adds a Sales Team field to each product so it can be tied to the sales team that owns it. This is a technical building block that other modules rely on, not a standalone feature. The field sits on the product form under General Information.

name: product_secondary_unit
summary: Lets you define secondary units of measure for a product, such as selling by weight while also tracking pieces or boxes, even when those units belong to a different unit category. Each secondary unit has a conversion factor and a setting that controls whether the two quantities update each other, stay independent, or prioritise the secondary one. It appears as a Secondary Unit of Measure section on the product's General Information tab.

name: product_sequence
summary: Automatically numbers products with an internal reference taken from a sequence, and lets each product category use its own prefix and sequence. Internal references must be unique and filled in. Category prefixes are set on the Product Category form.

name: product_set
summary: Lets you save a named group of products that are usually sold or ordered together, then add the whole group to a document in one step. Once added, each line can be edited or removed like any other line. This is the base feature; companion modules such as sale_product_set provide the screens for using it.

name: product_simple_seasonality
summary: Adds simple seasons, such as a recurring yearly period, that can be assigned to products and packagings. It is a way to mark which products belong to which season so other processes can act on them. Seasons are created by the user and picked on the product form.

name: product_state
summary: Adds a lifecycle state to products, such as In Development, Normal, End of Lifecycle, or Obsolete. Users pick the state from buttons at the top of the product form. The available states are maintained as a list of product states.

name: product_state_active
summary: Lets a product state archive or reactivate the products that carry it. Choosing a state marked to activate or deactivate changes whether the product is active. States are set under Sales > Configuration > Products > Product States.

name: product_state_sale
summary: Makes product states available in Sales, so the product lifecycle status is visible to the sales side. This is a thin link module: the states themselves are set up under Sales > Configuration > Products > Product States, and no new screens are added.

name: product_state_stock_base
summary: Makes product states available in Inventory, using the same state setup as the product lifecycle module. States are created under Inventory > Configuration > Products > Product States. No new fields are added by this module.

name: product_status
summary: Computes a status on each product (end of life, discontinued, or new) from date fields on the product's Sales tab. End of life takes priority over discontinued until, which takes priority over new until. Because the status is based on today's date, it updates by itself without anyone editing the product.

name: product_sticker
summary: Lets you attach sticker images, such as ISO, ecology or safety logos, to product attributes, attribute values and categories, with optional text under the image. It is a base module meant for other modules to build on, for example to print a legally required eco logo on delivery slips. Stickers are managed under Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Product Stickers.

name: product_stock_state
summary: Shows a stock state on each product at a glance: In Stock, In Limited Stock, Resupplying, or Out of Stock. The state compares available quantity to a threshold, and a positive forecast means resupplying. Thresholds can be set company-wide, per category, or per product, and the state shows in the product list.

name: product_supplierinfo_archive
summary: Lets you archive individual vendor price lines on a product, so an old supplier price can be hidden without being deleted. Archiving applies to new product variants only, existing variants are not changed. Use the archive action on any vendor price line.

name: product_supplierinfo_comment
summary: Adds a comment field to each vendor price line on a product, for notes about a supplier's price or terms. The comment is stored on the vendor price record and shows in the product's Purchase tab.

name: product_supplierinfo_import
summary: Imports vendor price lists from Excel files, matching products by any product field such as the internal reference. Import templates map each spreadsheet column to an Odoo field, and the import creates or updates vendor prices with a start date and lead time. Found under Purchase > Configuration > Import vendor pricelists.

name: product_supplierinfo_import_margin
summary: Extends the vendor pricelist import wizard so you can set a sale margin on the imported prices as they come in. The margin is carried to the resulting price list lines. It needs the supplier pricelist sale margin feature installed.

name: product_supplierinfo_revision
summary: Lets you duplicate vendor price lists into a new version valid from a chosen start date, optionally with a percentage increase or decrease. The previous price is kept on the new line so you can see how prices changed over time. Used from the Vendor Pricelists list with the Duplicate Supplier Info action.

name: product_supplierinfo_stock_picking_type
summary: Lets you choose a specific receipt operation type for each vendor price line, so purchases from a given supplier go to a chosen incoming type. It shows on the product's Purchase tab in the vendor lines. Storage locations must be turned on in Inventory settings.

name: product_tag_view
summary: Shows product tags on the General Information tab of the product and variant forms. In standard Odoo the tags sit under the Sales tab, which is hidden for products not marked as sellable, so this makes tags visible and editable for purchase-only products too.

name: product_tags_code
summary: Adds a unique code to product tags, so a tag can be referenced by a short code instead of its name. Codes are entered on the tag form, which is reached from the product form.

name: product_tier_validation
summary: Adds an approval step for new products. A new product stays archived in the In Development state until an approver signs off through the Request Validation button and the Reviews section. Approval rules are set up as tier definitions in the tier validation settings.

name: product_total_weight_from_packaging
summary: Estimates the total weight of a given quantity of a product using the weights of its packagings, falling back to the product weight when no packaging weight is set. The result is returned in the product's unit of measure. All weights are assumed to be in kilograms, so this is an estimate for shipping or logistics planning.

name: product_uom_updatable
summary: Lets you change a product's unit of measure after it has already been used in a stock transfer, as long as the new unit is in the same category and has the same conversion factor. This relaxes the normal lock on unit of measure changes.

name: product_usability
summary: Adds a main Product menu that gathers all product-related entries, such as products, attributes, pricelists, units of measure, categories and tags, in one place. It also adds access rules so users can create products and attributes without full Inventory or Sales manager rights. This is a technical extension of product access and menus.

name: product_variant_route_mto
summary: Lets you turn make-to-order (MTO) on for individual product variants, even when the parent product is not MTO. A variant can be marked MTO on its own, but cannot be set to non-MTO while its template is MTO. The setting sits on the variant's inventory route options.

name: purchase_product_template_tags
summary: Adds a Product Tags menu under the Purchase app, so purchasers can open and manage product tags from there. It adds only the menu entry and no other changes.

name: sale_product_template_tags
summary: Adds a Product Tags menu under the Sales app, so salespeople can open and manage product tags from there. It adds only the menu entry and no other changes.

name: stock_lot_production_date
summary: Adds a Production Date field to lot and serial numbers, so you can record when each lot or serial was manufactured. It shows on the lot or serial number form in Inventory.

name: uom_alias
summary: Lets you give a unit of measure one or more alternative names, such as a supplier's code for Unit, and then find the unit by any of those names. This is useful when reading supplier invoices whose unit codes differ from Odoo. Aliases are added on each unit of measure under Inventory > Settings > UoM Categories.

name: uom_category_active
summary: Lets you archive units of measure categories, so unused categories disappear from the lists while keeping their history. Use the Archive button on the category form under Inventory > Configuration > Units of Measure > UoM Categories.

name: product_pack
summary: Lets you define a product as a pack, which is a bundle of other products sold together. You set the pack type and how component prices are charged, then choose the products that make up the pack. This is the base for the sale and purchase pack features and on its own adds the pack settings to the product form.

name: purchase_product_pack
summary: Lets purchase orders use product packs, so a pack added to a request for quotation or purchase order line can be expanded into its components. The pack type and component price settings decide how the lines appear and what they cost. Found under Purchase when adding order lines.

name: sale_product_pack
summary: Lets sales orders use product packs, so a pack added to a quotation or sales order expands into its component lines. The pack type and component price settings control how the pack is shown and priced to the customer, with an optional discount per component. Found under Sales when adding order lines.

name: sale_stock_product_pack
summary: Makes packs that are stored products work correctly across sales and inventory, so delivered quantities are counted properly and a storable pack can be invoiced when shipped. It is a compatibility layer and adds no screens of its own.

name: stock_product_pack
summary: Shows On Hand and Forecasted quantities for a pack based on the stock of its components, so you can see how many packs can be made. Packs can be set so they do not create their own stock moves, and component moves are created as usual.

name: partner_supplierinfo_smartbutton
summary: Adds a Products Supplied button to a vendor's contact form. Clicking it lists the products that vendor supplies, based on the vendor pricelists set on the products. It is found on the vendor contact under Contacts or Purchase > Orders > Vendors.

name: procurement_purchase_no_grouping
summary: Controls whether purchase orders created automatically from replenishment are grouped together. Each product category can use standard grouping, no line grouping, or no order grouping, falling back to a company default. The setting is made on the product category form and in Purchase settings.

name: procurement_purchase_sale_no_grouping
summary: Makes the no order grouping option work for service products sold on sales orders that generate purchases, so each sale creates its own purchase order instead of joining an existing one. It is a glue module between the no-grouping and sale-purchase features, set on the product category form.

name: product_main_seller
summary: Shows each product's main vendor, which is the first vendor in its vendor list, as a field on the product form. It makes it quick to see who a product is normally bought from. It is found on the product form's Purchase tab.

name: product_supplier_code_purchase
summary: Shows the vendor's own product code on purchase order lines, taken from the vendor price for that product. It helps purchasers match a line to the supplier's catalogue. It appears as a column on the purchase order lines.

name: product_supplierinfo_disable_autocreation
summary: Adds a switch in Purchase settings that stops Odoo from automatically creating vendor price lines when purchase orders are validated. Turn it off if purchases should not add or update supplier prices. It is in the Orders section of the purchasing settings.

name: product_supplierinfo_purchase_contact
summary: Adds a Purchase Contact field to vendor price lines, so a different contact can receive purchase orders created from replenishment for that price. It is set on the vendor pricelist, and the contact is used when ordering from Replenishment.

name: product_supplierinfo_qty_multiplier
summary: Lets a vendor price line carry a multiplier quantity, such as cases of 6, so purchase quantities are rounded up to a full multiple. Ordering 9 units on a multiplier of 6 becomes 12. The multiplier is set on the vendor pricelist line in the product's Purchase tab.

name: product_supplierinfo_update_price
summary: Updates the product's vendor price from a purchase order line. When the price on the line differs from the vendor price list, a refresh button appears next to the unit price so you can save the new price in one click. It works from the purchase order form.

name: purchase_advance_payment
summary: Lets you pay a vendor in advance on a purchase order, before or during billing. Advance payments are recorded with a Pay Purchase Advance button, and when the vendor bill is created you choose which advances to attach to it. The advances are listed on the purchase order.

name: purchase_all_shipments
summary: Replaces the In Shipments button on a purchase order with All Shipments, which shows the original receipt plus every other receipt linked to it through chained or grouped procurements. This matches how the sales module shows all deliveries from a sales order. It is found on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_allowed_product
summary: Restricts product choices on purchase orders and vendor bills to the products the chosen vendor supplies. Turn it on for a vendor and its purchases and bills only offer products that vendor is listed for. It is set on the contact under Sales and Purchases.

name: purchase_analytic_global
summary: Adds one analytic distribution on a purchase order that applies to all of its lines at once, so you do not have to set analytic accounts line by line. It is set on the purchase order header.

name: purchase_blanket_order
summary: Lets you agree a blanket order with a vendor: a set quantity of products at a fixed price, valid until a set date. Confirmed blanket orders are then used to create new purchase orders at that price until the quantity is used up or the validity ends. It is found under the Purchase menu as Blanket Orders.

name: purchase_cancel_confirm
summary: When a user clicks Cancel on a purchase order from the form or list view, a confirmation wizard appears where an optional reason can be entered. The reason, user and date are stored on the order. Orders cancelled by other flows, such as merging RFQs, are not affected.

name: purchase_cancel_reason
summary: Requires a reason from a configured list whenever a draft, RFQ or purchase order is cancelled. The chosen reason is stamped on the order, so you can later report why orders were cancelled. Reasons are set up under Purchase > Configuration.

name: purchase_commercial_partner
summary: Adds a stored Commercial Vendor field to purchase orders, showing the parent company behind the vendor contact. You can group RFQs and purchase orders by it in the search view, so contacts of the same company roll up together. It works like the Commercial Partner field on invoices.

name: purchase_container
summary: Adds container details to purchase orders and receipts, such as container type, reference, bill of lading number, shipping agent, volume and cost. Containers link to the purchase order and to the incoming transfer, which helps track goods shipped in containers.

name: purchase_default_terms_conditions
summary: Puts default terms and conditions on purchase orders, taken from the company or from the vendor. You turn on the default terms option in Purchase settings, enter the company text, and can add vendor-specific terms on the vendor contact. They then appear on new quotations.

name: purchase_delivery_split_date
summary: Creates one receipt per scheduled date when a purchase order is confirmed, so products due on different days arrive on separate receipts. If the scheduled dates on the lines change later, the receipts are reorganised to match.

name: purchase_deposit
summary: Lets you take a deposit from a vendor on a confirmed purchase order, as a percentage or a fixed amount, using a Register Deposit button. The deposit is billed as a vendor bill line, using a Purchase Deposit product set in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_exception
summary: Lets you attach customizable exceptions to purchase orders, such as a product not found or a wrong line format, and filter orders by exception type to fix them. It is especially useful when importing many orders at once and some contain errors. Exceptions can be ignored per line.

name: purchase_fop_shipping
summary: Sets a minimum purchase amount per vendor for free shipping, and flags purchase orders below it so users can add shipping costs or confirm anyway. The amount is set on the vendor contact and the order shows whether the threshold has been reached.

name: purchase_force_invoiced
summary: Lets you mark a confirmed and received purchase order as Fully Billed even when the vendor bill is lower than what was received, for example when a supplier disputes quantities. Force-invoiced orders also drop out of the vendor bill matching view. The checkbox is on the Other Information tab for users with the technical setting enabled.

name: purchase_force_invoiced_quantity
summary: Adds a Force Invoiced field on each purchase order line that reduces the quantity still to bill by a set amount. Use it to write off part of a line without a credit note. The field is optional and can be hidden.

name: purchase_invoice_method
summary: Lets you override how a purchase order is billed. You can allow a vendor bill before goods are received, or require receipt first. The Invoice Method is set on the Other Information tab of the purchase order.

name: purchase_invoice_plan
summary: Lets you plan vendor bills in advance for a purchase order, splitting the total into installments with set dates, intervals and percentages. Each installment can then be billed one at a time or all at once. The plan is added from an Invoice Plan tab once Use Invoice Plan is chosen on a quotation.

name: purchase_invoice_status_line
summary: Shows the billing status on each purchase order line and lets you force a line to be invoiced. Lines marked as force invoiced also drop out of the vendor bill matching view. The status is visible in the order lines list.

name: purchase_last_price_info
summary: Shows on each product the supplier, date and price from the most recent confirmed purchase order, including the price in the vendor's currency and its exchange rate. Buyers can check the last price paid before ordering again. It is found on the product's Purchase tab.

name: purchase_line_procurement_group
summary: Stops purchase order lines from being merged when replenishment runs come from different procurement groups, such as different sales orders. Each group gets its own purchase line and its own stock moves. This affects how replenishment creates purchase lines.

name: purchase_line_reassign
summary: Moves selected purchase order lines from one purchase order to another, either an existing order or a new one. You select the lines in a purchase order line list and choose Reassign Lines to Other Purchase. A list view of purchase order lines must be set up to use it.

name: purchase_line_vendor_comment
summary: Adds a vendor comment field on each purchase order line, for notes meant for the supplier. It is a simple text field on the line.

name: purchase_location_by_line
summary: Lets you set a destination location on each purchase order line. When the order is confirmed, one receipt is created per combination of destination and expected date, so goods can go to different locations within the same order. The destination shows on the order lines.

name: purchase_lot
summary: Adds a Serial Number (lot) field to purchase order lines and passes it to the receipt when the order is confirmed. Combined with the sale order lot selection module, it lets you buy a specific lot for a sales order.

name: purchase_manual_currency
summary: Lets you set a manual exchange rate on a draft purchase order in a foreign currency, for deals agreed on a different day than the order date. The rate you enter is used instead of the automatic one. It needs multi-currency access and is set on the purchase order header.

name: purchase_manual_delivery
summary: Stops receipts from being created automatically when a purchase order is confirmed. Instead, you create incoming shipments by hand for the lines the supplier has confirmed, using Create Incoming Shipment and picking the lines. It can be set per order or as a default in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_no_rfq
summary: Removes the Request for Quotation stage so purchasing works from a single Purchase Order menu. The Draft and Sent states replace the old RFQ names, and the Print button is always available. Users work with purchase orders from the start.

name: purchase_open_qty
summary: Adds filters on purchase orders to find orders with quantities still to bill or still to receive. It also adds quantity-to-bill and quantity-to-receive fields on orders and lines. The new filters are in the purchase orders search bar.

name: purchase_order_approval_block
summary: Lets you put a block on an RFQ with a reason, which stops it being approved until a manager releases the block. Reasons are set under Purchases > Configuration. A Blocked filter finds orders waiting on a block.

name: purchase_order_approved
summary: Adds an Approved state between draft and Purchase Order, giving purchasing a two-step confirmation. Approved orders cannot be edited, can be set back to draft, and do not create receipts until they are converted to a Purchase Order. It is turned on in Purchase settings or per vendor.

name: purchase_order_archive
summary: Lets you archive purchase orders that are locked or cancelled, so the purchase orders list stays manageable on high-volume systems. Archived orders are hidden from the list and can be shown again with the Archived filter. Use Action > Archive on the list.

name: purchase_order_date_approve_editable
summary: Makes the Approval Date on a purchase order editable after confirmation, until the order is locked. By default Odoo makes this date read-only once confirmed. It is found on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_order_etd_eta
summary: Adds Estimated Time of Departure and Arrival dates and a shipping schedule note to purchase orders, and shows them on the purchase order and RFQ reports. You can hide the expected arrival date on reports when an ETA is set, in Purchase settings.

name: purchase_order_general_discount
summary: Adds one general discount percentage to a purchase order, applied to every line. A default discount can be set on the vendor, and settings choose which line discount field it feeds, such as a third discount from the triple discount module. It is entered in the order summary.

name: purchase_order_internal_note
summary: Adds an Internal Note field to purchase orders for notes only the team should see. The note is kept off the printed purchase order report.

name: purchase_order_line_description
summary: Uses only the product's purchase description on purchase order lines, instead of the sales description. Set the purchase description on the product and new lines take that text.

name: purchase_order_line_effective_date
summary: Shows Effective Date and Last Effective Date on purchase order lines, based on when goods were actually received. It helps compare when goods arrived against the committed date. It is visible on purchase order lines and the purchase report.

name: purchase_order_line_menu
summary: Adds a Purchase Order Lines menu under Purchase > Orders, so you can browse and filter all purchase order lines in one list instead of opening each order. Invoice status and order date are shown on the lines.

name: purchase_order_line_merge
summary: Lets you select purchase order lines from different orders and merge them into one new purchase order. Lines with the same product, price, unit and taxes combine into one line, and partial merges leave the remainder on the original order. Use Action > Merge into Purchase Order on the Purchase Order Lines list.

name: purchase_order_line_note
summary: Adds a Note field to purchase order lines so you can write free text on a line.

name: purchase_order_line_original_date
summary: Keeps the original expected arrival date on each purchase order and line, even after the planned date is changed. This lets you measure a vendor's real delay against what was first promised. It is shown on the purchase order and its lines.

name: purchase_order_line_sequence
summary: Numbers purchase order lines (1, 2, 3 and so on) so they appear in order on the order, the quotation report and the vendor bill. If the stock line sequence module is also installed, the numbers carry over to receipts. A Line Number column appears on the order.

name: purchase_order_line_stock_available
summary: Shows the forecasted stock quantity for each product on purchase order lines, so buyers can see stock levels while ordering. It is added as a column on the purchase line.

name: purchase_order_owner
summary: Adds an Assign Owner field to purchase orders, which is passed to the receipt on confirmation. Use it when you buy goods on behalf of a client who owns the stock while you keep it in your warehouse. It is found on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_order_price_recalculation
summary: Adds a button below the lines of a purchase order that reprices all lines from the current vendor's prices. Use it after changing the vendor or duplicating an order, when you want prices updated. It is a manual action, so prices do not change on their own.

name: purchase_order_product_recommendation
summary: Adds a Recommended Products wizard to purchase orders. It lists products the chosen vendor supplies that were most often delivered to customers in a date range, so buyers can add likely needed items quickly. You set or adjust quantities and press Accept.

name: purchase_order_product_recommendation_brand
summary: Adds a brand filter to the Recommended Products wizard on purchase orders, so suggestions can be narrowed to chosen product brands. It needs the product brand module.

name: purchase_order_product_recommendation_secondary_unit
summary: Lets the Recommended Products wizard set order quantities in a product's secondary unit where one is defined, such as boxes instead of pieces. It needs the purchase secondary unit module.

name: purchase_order_product_recommendation_xlsx
summary: Adds an Export button to the Recommended Products wizard, so the suggested products for a supplier can be downloaded as a spreadsheet after quantities are adjusted.

name: purchase_order_qty_change_no_recompute
summary: Stops the purchase order line unit price from being recalculated when only the quantity is changed. A custom unit price you typed in stays as it is. It affects editing of purchase order lines.

name: purchase_order_secondary_unit
summary: Lets buyers enter purchase quantities and prices in a product's secondary unit on purchase order lines, and the main quantity is calculated from the conversion factor. Vendor pricelists support secondary unit prices, and purchase reports and the vendor portal show figures in the chosen unit.

name: purchase_order_supplier_return
summary: Lets you return products to a supplier by creating a purchase order with a negative quantity. When that order's receipt is validated, the received quantity is reduced accordingly. It only works for storable products.

name: purchase_order_supplierinfo_update
summary: Automatically updates each product's vendor price and discount with the price from a confirmed purchase order, so the next order suggests the last price paid. It happens each time a request for quotation is confirmed.

name: purchase_order_type
summary: Adds a configurable Purchase Order Type to purchase orders, such as Standard or Services, with its own numbering sequence, payment terms and incoterm. Use it in filters and group-bys to report by type. Types are set up under Purchases > Configuration.

name: purchase_order_type_dashboard
summary: Adds a dashboard of purchase orders grouped by Purchase Order Type, showing counts of RFQs, orders waiting for bills, and orders with nothing to bill. Each type's tile opens its orders.

name: purchase_order_uninvoiced_amount
summary: Shows the amount not yet billed on each purchase order in the purchase order list view. You can see at a glance which orders still have value to bill.

name: purchase_order_uninvoiced_amount_line
summary: Shows the amount not yet billed on each purchase order line in the purchase order lines list.

name: purchase_partner_incoterm
summary: Sets a default Incoterm and Incoterm address on each vendor, which fill in automatically on new purchase orders. This lets you set shipping terms and the place of delivery once per vendor. It is set on the vendor contact and shows on the purchase order.

name: purchase_partner_selectable_option
summary: Adds a Selectable in purchase orders switch on vendor contacts. Vendors with it switched off do not appear in the vendor field of new purchase orders. It can be defaulted to off with a system parameter.

name: purchase_receipt_expectation
summary: A technical base for controlling how receipts are created when a purchase order is approved. It adds a Receipt Expectation field on purchase orders, set to automatic by default, which other modules can extend with custom receipt rules. It has no screens of its own beyond that field.

name: purchase_reception_notify
summary: Notifies the people following a purchase order as soon as its products are received into stock, by posting a message on the order. It adds a new message type for these notifications, and existing active followers are updated to receive them. The notice is triggered when a receipt is validated.

name: purchase_reception_status
summary: Shows a reception status on each purchase order: Nothing Received, Partially Received, or Fully Received. Purchase managers can force a locked order to Fully Received with a Force Received checkbox. It is found on the purchase order's Other Information tab.

name: purchase_reception_status_line
summary: Shows a reception status on each purchase order line (nothing, partial or fully received) and rolls them up into the order status. Managers can force a line to fully received. It works best with the purchase order lines menu installed.

name: purchase_representative
summary: Sets the Purchase Representative on a purchase order to the user who ran the procurement, so the RFQ or order is sent from that person and replies go to them. It fixes the case where orders are created under the system user.

name: purchase_request
summary: Lets staff raise internal requests for materials or outside services, with quantities and needed-by dates, before anyone creates a purchase order. Requests can be entered by hand or created automatically from manufacturing or sales demand. Buyers turn approved request lines into RFQs, adding to an existing RFQ or creating a new one for a chosen supplier. It is found under the Purchase menu as Purchase Requests.

name: purchase_request_cancel_confirm
summary: When a user cancels a purchase request, a confirmation wizard appears with an optional reason. It is shown from the request's cancel action.

name: purchase_request_department
summary: Adds a Department field to purchase requests and their lines, filled in automatically from the requester's department. You can group the request list by department. It depends on the employees app.

name: purchase_request_exception
summary: Lets you attach customizable exceptions to purchase requests, such as a product not found, and filter requests by exception type to fix them. It is useful when a batch of requests has errors during import.

name: purchase_request_substate
summary: Lets you add sub-stages to a purchase request within each main status, such as To Verify before approval. Sub-stages are defined as base substates under Settings > Technical > Database Structure, and their sequence matters. They show in the request's form header.

name: purchase_request_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval process to purchase requests. Requests are sent for review with Request Validation, reviewers approve in the Reviews tab, and Confirm appears once all are approved. A default tier lets a Purchase Request Manager approve, and more tiers can be added in the tier validation settings.

name: purchase_request_to_requisition
summary: Lets buyers turn selected purchase request lines into a purchase agreement, either adding them to a draft agreement or creating a new one. The module tries to combine lines for the same product into one agreement line. It is used from Purchase Requests by selecting lines and choosing Create Purchase Agreement under More.

name: purchase_request_type
summary: Adds a configurable Type to purchase requests, such as Standard or Urgent, which can be used in filters and group-bys. A type can also skip RFQ creation, so the request stops at approval. Types are managed under Purchases > Configuration.

name: purchase_requisition_line_description
summary: Shows the product's purchase description on purchase agreement lines, instead of only the product name. Set the purchase description on the product first.

name: purchase_requisition_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval process to purchase agreements. Agreements are sent for review with Request Validation, and the Confirm button appears once all reviewers approve. Tiers are configured in the tier validation settings.

name: purchase_rfq_number
summary: Gives quotations (RFQs) their own number sequence, separate from purchase orders. For example, RFQ001 becomes PO001 when confirmed, and the RFQ number is kept for reference. It can also auto-attach the RFQ after confirmation. Set in Purchases > Configuration.

name: purchase_sale_link_by_origin
summary: Links purchase orders and sales orders also by the purchase Source Document field, not only by their lines. This keeps the link when a purchase is cancelled or when the origin is typed in by hand.

name: purchase_security
summary: Restricts which purchase orders each purchase user can see. Purchase users see their own orders, or their team's orders if they are in a purchase team, and the module adds Purchase Teams plus a Purchase Representative on vendors and orders. Groups are set in users' access rights.

name: purchase_stock_cost_update
summary: Lets you update the cost of goods already received from a purchase order by changing the price on the order line, which adjusts the stock valuation. The valuation difference is shown on the order. It requires average cost valuation on the product category.

name: purchase_stock_line_sequence
summary: Carries the purchase order line numbers over to the stock moves of the receipt, and stops those numbers being edited on the receipt. It is installed automatically when both the purchase line numbers and the picking line numbers modules are installed.

name: purchase_stock_manual_currency
summary: Passes the manual exchange rate set on a purchase order through to the receipt's stock moves, valuation layers and product costs. It keeps stock costs consistent with the rate agreed with the vendor. It adds no new screens.

name: purchase_stock_packaging
summary: Carries the product packaging chosen on a sales order or procurement through to the generated purchase order line, so the purchase uses the same packaging. It is useful for make-to-order routes that create purchases.

name: purchase_stock_price_unit_sync
summary: Updates the cost price on receipt stock moves that are already done when the purchase line price changes, so stock valuation follows the price. It is designed to work with the average cost price sync module.

name: purchase_stock_reception_status
summary: Glue module that makes the purchase reception status use the OCA logic when both the reception status and the purchase-stock features are installed. It hides duplicate reception status displays so the order shows one clear status. No setup is needed.

name: purchase_stock_secondary_unit
summary: Copies secondary unit quantities and prices from a purchase order line to the receipt when the order is confirmed, so the receipt shows the quantity in the secondary unit. It needs the purchase secondary unit and stock secondary unit modules.

name: purchase_substate
summary: Lets you add sub-stages to a purchase order within each main status, such as Waiting for legal documents before approval. Sub-stages are defined as base substates under Settings > Technical > Database Structure and are shown in the order header.

name: purchase_tag
summary: Lets you add multiple tags to purchase orders, organised as a hierarchy of parent and child tags, and filter or group orders by tag. Tags are picked on the purchase order form.

name: purchase_tier_validation
summary: Adds a multi-level approval process to purchase orders. A user requests validation with a button, reviewers approve in the Reviews tab, and Confirm Order becomes available once all approvals are in. A Needs my Review filter helps reviewers find their items. Tiers are set in the tier validation settings.

name: purchase_triple_discount
summary: Gives each purchase order line three successive discounts, applied one after another, instead of a single discount. Each vendor can have default discounts that fill in automatically. Lines show Disc. 1, Disc. 2 and Disc. 3.

name: purchase_uninvoiced_amount_force_invoiced_line
summary: Glue module that sets a line's uninvoiced amount to zero when the line is force invoiced, so a force-invoiced line no longer shows an outstanding amount.

name: purchase_warn_message
summary: Adds a warning message field on purchase orders and shows it as a popup, so the warning is populated not only when the vendor changes. It is an extra alert on the order.

name: purchase_warn_option
summary: Adds predefined warning options to vendors and products, so a blocking or caution message can be picked from a list and applied quickly. The vendor's option shows on purchase orders, and the product's option appears when that product is purchased. Set under the Purchase settings Warnings option, the vendor's Internal Notes tab, and the product's Purchase tab.
